request.query: Real power comparison at infinity exponent gap absorbs arbitrary multiplicative constants

items.name: NNReal.tendsto_rpow_atTop
items.type: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 < y → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => x ^ y) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

items.name: isLittleO_pow_pow_of_lt_left
items.type: ∀ {r₁ r₂ : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r₁ → r₁ < r₂ → (fun n => r₁ ^ n) =o[Filter.atTop] fun n => r₂ ^ n

items.name: isLittleO_pow_pow_of_abs_lt_left
items.type: ∀ {r₁ r₂ : ℝ}, |r₁| < |r₂| → (fun n => r₁ ^ n) =o[Filter.atTop] fun n => r₂ ^ n

items.name: Asymptotics.IsBigOWith.of_pow
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {R : Type u_13} [inst : SeminormedRing R] {S : Type u_17} [inst_1 : NormedRing S] [NormMulClass S]
  {c c' : ℝ} {l : Filter α} [NormOneClass S] {n : ℕ} {f : α → S} {g : α → R},
  Asymptotics.IsBigOWith c l (f ^ n) (g ^ n) → n ≠ 0 → c ≤ c' ^ n → 0 ≤ c' → Asymptotics.IsBigOWith c' l f g

items.name: tendsto_pow_div_pow_atTop_atTop
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : Field 𝕜] [inst_1 : LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] {p q : ℕ},
  q < p → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => x ^ p / x ^ q) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

items.name: Asymptotics.IsBigOWith.rpow
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {r c : ℝ} {l : Filter α} {f g : α → ℝ},
  Asymptotics.IsBigOWith c l f g →
    0 ≤ c → 0 ≤ r → 0 ≤ᶠ[l] g → Asymptotics.IsBigOWith (c ^ r) l (fun x => f x ^ r) fun x => g x ^ r

items.name: ENNReal.tendsto_rpow_at_top

items.name: Asymptotics.isLittleO_pow_pow_atTop_of_lt
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [OrderTopology 𝕜] {p q : ℕ},
  p < q → (fun x => x ^ p) =o[Filter.atTop] fun x => x ^ q
